session: Dev sessions (HS256 dev JWTs) against the API in memory mode on 127.0.0.1:3411, seeded by a script: a runner's race 'Leadville 2027' created, set paid (POST /entitlement, unlimited crew), course from fixtures/pacing/course-50k-with-aids.gpx (gpx-preview then PUT /course, start 2027-08-15 12:00Z), and a crew member joined by code. Each user's onboarding progress file was written as a phone that finished setup leaves it (runner: account, history, teaser, preview done; crew: choice crew), then the app was launched with --deeplink crewcue://dev/app-shell --api-base-url <api> --dev-session <user> <athlete|crew_member> <token> <roomId>. Offline: the app talked to the API through a TCP proxy on 127.0.0.1:3412 that was then killed. Location: simctl location set at the course start (39.1502,-120.2501); denial via simctl privacy revoke location.
action: Standard iPhone, runner tour-runner: the shell opened on Profile with card 1 of 5 'Invite your crew' above the Profile tab, its ring on that tab. Share invite opened the system share sheet with the race's invite text; after it, the second button read Next and saved the step. Card 2 (no ring, centred): Turn on notifications showed the system prompt; Allow saved it done (the simulator gave no APNs token, so no POST /push-registrations went out: push registration itself is the push-registration row). Card 3 on Map: Test tracking now showed the When In Use prompt, then the Always prompt; the first ping (POST /pings/batch 200) turned the Map chip to 'LAST PING: JUST NOW' and the card to 'Test ping sent.'; tracking stopped. Card 4 zoomed the map to the START marker with the test ping's dot on it. Card 5 on Chat, Done. Map then showed 'Race setup 3 of 5 done' with Adjust aid station stops next; Show all listed all five (invites, notifications, location struck through); Adjust aid station stops opened Pace in Edit planned stops and the card read 4 of 5. Second runner err-runner: card 2 read 'Notifications are on.' with Next (permission already on); location denied gave the Error copy and Try again; with the API behind a killed proxy, Test tracking now gave the Offline copy. Duo runner duo-runner: outer display card 1 clear of the camera column; Later; card 2; unfolded to the inner display with card 2 of 5 kept; Not now; relaunch resumed on card 3 of 5, placed above the Map tab on the wide display; Test tracking now, While Using, then the ping, then Change to Always Allow: the card's line changed from the When In Use copy to 'Test ping sent. Your crew will see your dot. Tracking is off until you start it on race day.' and the location arrow went away; Next zoomed to the start; folded to the outer display with card 4 of 5 kept; Next, Done; checklist 1 of 5 on the outer display; unfolded, Show all scrolled inside the card with the top bar kept; Hide removed the card. Dev route signed out: cards 1-2 of 5 on the fixture tab bar; ?state=empty shows 'Race tour' / 'Unlock your race to start the tour.'
